text: Given a group that is role-assignable in Graph (isAssignableToRole: true), When graph_list_groups lists it (e.g. "test two" on INT tenant 2qmxyw), Then that group's entry has isAssignableToRole: true and the Graph $select sent by the tool includes isAssignableToRole.

Given ordinary groups where Graph returns isAssignableToRole as false and as null, When graph_list_groups lists them, Then each entry keeps that exact value unchanged (null is never converted to false).

text: Given groups with onPremisesSyncEnabled true, false and null, When graph_list_groups lists them, Then sync_source is "on-premises" only when onPremisesSyncEnabled is truthy, else "cloud" -- the same rule graph_get_group uses -- and onPremisesSyncEnabled is present in the Graph $select.

text: Given the same group on both connectors, When graph_list_groups on this single-tenant connector (INT tenant 2qmxyw, group "test two") is compared to the GDAP connector's graph_list_groups for the same group, Then isAssignableToRole, onPremisesSyncEnabled and sync_source match.
steps: On INT tenant 2qmxyw, call this connector's graph_list_groups with display_name="test two", exact=true
Record isAssignableToRole, onPremisesSyncEnabled, sync_source from the result
Call the GDAP connector's graph_list_groups for the same tenant/group
Compare the three fields between both results
expect: isAssignableToRole, onPremisesSyncEnabled and sync_source are identical between the two connectors for the same group
evidence: needs a live INT tenant (2qmxyw) with both connectors deployed; not executable from DEV01's sandbox (no network to live Microsoft Graph / live INT services). Not a blocker per references/mcp-track.md ("missing a real vendor account is not a blocker") -- flagged for post-merge/INT verification. Report as not-run, not as passed.
